chose: a warm-only Structure refresh reads a language with no server to ask (none loaded, or read inside its own bounds) through an adapter that answers nothing itself, so the reading reuses kept answers and leaves the language unread only when a question has none
over: starting a server for the unloaded language in the refresh, or recording a reading with that language unread
because: the refresh must start no server, and a partial reading is never kept; kept answers are exactly what the server answered for the unchanged files, the same reuse a non-warm reading already makes before it starts its server
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
